title: OBHS STEM Club Structure Pack
description: This modpack adds 10 new handcrafted structures that make Minecraft exploration subtly more exciting, offering unexpected fights, valuable treasure, and fun surprises to enrich every journey.
body: This modpack adds 10 unique structures, 7 on land and 3 in water, that subtly enhance Minecraft exploration and travel. The structures include Enchanted Islands, Mushroom House, Golden Tree, Viking Ship, Ocean Hut, Basic Campfire, Basic Raft, Target Practice, Roman Building, and Ruined Castle. With exciting fights, valuable loot, and fun surprises, every adventure is richer and more enjoyable.
